note: Starter programmes. Each entry was read from the official university pages in sourceUrl (and the pages named in its notes) on checkedAt. None is marked as confirmed by the university. Fields a page did not state are left empty.

programmes.name: Data Science MSc
programmes.tuitionNote: International fee for 2026/27 entry. A £1,900 placement fee applies only if you secure a professional placement.
programmes.deadlineNote: Final deadline for international applicants starting in March 2027. January 2027 closes 1 December 2026, May 2027 on 5 April 2027 and July 2027 on 25 May 2027.
programmes.academicRequirement: An honours degree at 2:2 or above (or the international equivalent) in any subject. This is a conversion course.
programmes.languageRequirement: An English language test score. A UK Student visa needs at least CEFR B2 in reading, listening, writing and speaking; Coventry states the course's own English requirement in your offer letter, which may be higher.

requiredDocuments.note: All academic transcripts.
Copies of your degree or diploma certificates (or a work reference if you are employed).
One academic reference.
An English language test score.
A copy of your current passport.

programmes.name: Data Science BSc (Hons)
programmes.degreeName: Bachelor of Science with Honours (BSc Hons)
programmes.tuitionNote: International fee for 2027/28 entry, charged for the first year; the university reviews fees each year. A four-year sandwich option with a placement year is also offered.
programmes.academicRequirement: Typical offers: A levels BBB including Mathematics at grade B, or the IB Diploma with 29 points including 5 in Higher Level Mathematics. Coventry considers a wide range of other qualifications; see the international entry requirements on the course page. A version with a foundation year is offered if you do not have the required grades.

requiredDocuments.note: All academic transcripts.
Copies of your certificates.
One academic reference.
An English language test score.
A copy of your current passport.

programmes.name: Medicine (MD)
programmes.degreeName: Doctor of Medicine (dr. med., M.D.), a six-year degree entered after secondary school
programmes.tuitionNote: The programme page does not say which academic year this fee is for. Scholarships and merit-based fee discounts are offered.
programmes.deadlineNote: For the September 2027 intake, self-financed applicants. Scholarship applications have their own deadlines.
programmes.academicRequirement: A high school certificate, and an entrance examination in biology and physics or chemistry (written and oral), or completing the university's Basic Medicine Course.
programmes.languageRequirement: English at B2 level or above, shown by a standardized certificate from a proctored exam. Native speakers and applicants who studied in English can be exempted with a medium of instruction certificate. English is also assessed at the entrance examination.
programmes.otherRequirements: An entrance procedure fee of 350 USD (examination and interview) is paid on top of the 150 USD application fee; both are non-refundable. From the third year students learn some basic Hungarian to talk with patients.

requiredDocuments.note: School leaving certificate (or university degree), in English or translated.
If you are in your final year: transcripts of the last 2 to 3 years and your predicted grades.
Proof of citizenship, such as your passport.
A short CV: personal details, education, work experience, languages and other skills.
A B2 or higher English certificate, unless you are exempt.
A medical certificate, using the university's template.

programmes.name: General Medicine (MD)
programmes.degreeName: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.), a six-year one-tier master's degree entered after secondary school
programmes.tuitionNote: For students starting in 2027/28: 9,000 USD in the first semester and 7,750 USD in the second, each year. A 220 USD registration fee is paid with the first semester.
programmes.deadlineNote: Online application deadline for 2027/28 on the university's application portal; deadlines can differ by citizenship. Studies start on 1 September 2027.
programmes.academicRequirement: A high school diploma and official transcript, with the best possible grades in chemistry and biology, and eligibility for higher education in your home country. Admission includes an entrance examination.
programmes.languageRequirement: Upper-intermediate (B2) English. No language certificate is needed; English is part of the entrance examination.
programmes.otherRequirements: Entrance exam fee of 250 USD if you take it in Pécs. The application portal also lists a 900 USD deposit per semester. Medical documents (a medical certificate, a health history form, a chest X-ray note, hepatitis B immunisation or test results, and an HIV test) are collected before enrolment. There are 180 places.

requiredDocuments.note: A passport-size photo.
A copy of your valid passport.
A Europass CV in English with a photo.
Official secondary school leaving certificate, in English or with an authorised translation.
Official secondary school transcript, in English or with an authorised translation.
Medical documents, needed before enrolment rather than at application.

programmes.name: Informatics MSc
programmes.tuitionNote: For students from outside the EU/EEA, plus a 97 euro student fee each semester. TUM says master's tuition rises to 4,600 or 6,800 euros a semester for students starting from the winter semester 2027/28.
programmes.deadlineNote: Winter semester applications: 1 February to 31 May. Summer semester applications: 1 October to 30 November.
programmes.academicRequirement: A recognised undergraduate degree (such as a bachelor's) and passing TUM's aptitude assessment: your bachelor's grades and written documents are scored, and some applicants are invited to an interview. Degrees from outside Germany need Preliminary Documentation (VPD) from uni-assist.
programmes.languageRequirement: Proof of English language proficiency, submitted before the end of the application period.
programmes.otherRequirements: Apply through the TUMonline portal. TUM may ask for more documents depending on your education and country.

requiredDocuments.note: Degree certificate and diploma, or a transcript of your studies so far.
Transcript of records.
Proof of English language proficiency.
A letter of motivation and a separate essay, both in English.
A complete and current résumé.
A curricular analysis and module catalogue, plus uni-assist Preliminary Documentation (VPD) if your degree is from outside Germany.
